Salary uploads are not available for anonymous campaigns. Matching an employee's salary to their response would conflict with anonymity.

Optional annual base salary

Use a CSV with email, annual_base_salary, salary_currency. Annual base salary excludes bonuses, benefits, and overhead. USD is the only supported currency. Leave salary and currency blank for anyone whose cost you are not supplying.

Salary is sensitive personal information. Only upload it if company policy permits this use and you have authority to provide it. It is used for financial estimates, never diagnostic scoring. Participants are not shown the supplied salary or an upload notice. Salary files stay out of campaign drafts and must be selected again after a reload.

Use your organization's working-hours basis for this campaign.
Enter 0 if these costs should not be included.

We add your chosen percentage of base salary for benefits and overhead, then divide by annual working hours. Hourly employment cost = annual base salary × (1 + percentage ÷ 100) ÷ annual working hours. Both settings are required when supplying salaries. They are saved for this campaign when you send it and cannot then be changed. No default is applied.
